versions.changelog:
- Removed the entire "verified-agent-identity" skill, including all related scripts, documentation, and metadata files (24 files total).
- This update eliminates support for creating and verifying decentralized identities via the Billions Network.

- Added the new "verified-agent-identity" skill, including scripts, documentation, and utilities for creating and verifying decentralized agent identities.
- Introduced support for ERC-8004 identity standard and secure attestations.
- Included tools for linking agent and human identities using the Billions Network.
- Updated documentation in SKILL.md to reflect features and usage.

- Initial release of the skill enabling AI agents to create and verify decentralized identities via Billions Network.
- Supports ERC-8004 identity standard and secure attestations.
- Allows linking agent identities to human identities.
- Provides functionality to generate unique identities and verify credentials.
- Requires Node.js and access to the Billions Network.
